title: Extensive Form Perfect Equilibrium
body_html:
Extensive Form Perfect Equilibrium

An extensive form perfect equilibrium of a perfect-recall extensive form game $\Gamma$ is a perfect equilibrium of its agent normal form $\Gamma^a$.

This refinement applies normal-form perfection at the level of information-set agents rather than only to the original players' reduced normal form.

dependents.title: Normal And Extensive Perfection Can Differ
